info.title: TechBridge Phase 5 Resource Management
info.description: Backend-only extension of existing resource reservation. All protected responses are no-store. Access requires active JWT session, current database role and verified providers; no private admin override. Transactions require MongoDB replica set. No payment, background reminders or new frontend controls. Read resource-management.md for legacy/deployment limitations.

itemDetails.description: Existing category-specific contract: laptop requires brand/model/processor/processorGeneration/ramGb/storageGb/storageType; arduino model/microcontroller/operatingVoltage/digitalPins/analogPins; raspberryPi model/processor/ramGb/storageSupport; sensor sensorType/measuredParameter/operatingVoltage/interface; electronicComponent componentType/valueOrRating/packageType; devBoard boardModel/microcontrollerOrProcessor/memory/connectivity; other description. Bounded strings, finite nonnegative numeric values and valid storage enums remain enforced.

accessDetails.description: Existing contract by accessType: borrowShare borrowDurationDays/pickupLocation/returnCondition; rent pricePerMonth/currency/minRentalMonths, optional securityDeposit; installment totalPrice/downPayment/monthlyInstallmentAmount/numberOfMonths/lateFeePolicy; interestFree totalPrice/monthlyInstallmentAmount/numberOfMonths/eligibilityCriteria/repaymentStartDate, interestRate forced zero; sponsorship eligibilityCriteria/applicationDeadline/numberOfUnitsAvailable/sponsorOrganization; donation itemAgeYears/conditionNotes/pickupOrDeliveryMethod/claimDeadline. Positive integer periods/counts, nonnegative amounts, bounded text, age <=100 and future sponsorship/donation deadlines remain validated.

ResourceCreate.description: Borrow/share/rent require return. Donation/installment/interest_free transfer ownership. Sponsorship may opt into returnable with returnDurationDays. Version, moderation and inventory authority fields are server-owned.
